arabic text: AATI HAI SAKINA KI SADA KARBOBALA SE\nAMMU HO KAHAN AAO KE HUM HAI ABHI PYASE
english translation text: THE VOICE OF SAKINA RISES FROM THE LAND OF PAIN AND CALAMITY (KARBALA)\nO UNCLE, WHERE ARE YOU? COME FOR WE ARE STILL THIRSTY

arabic text: ATKA HAI JIGAR PYAS YE LE-LEGI MERI JAAN\nBACH BHI GAYI GAR SHIMR KE DURRO KI SAZA SE
english translation text: THE HEART IS ABOUT TO STOP, THIS THIRST WILL TAKE MY LIFE\nEVEN IF I AM TO SPARED THE PUNISHMENT AT SHIMR'S HANDS

arabic text: BAYSHEER KE HONTON PE NAHI PYAS KA SHIKWA\nTAR KARDIYA AADA NE GALA TEERE JAFA SE
english translation text: THERE IS NO COMPLAIN UPON THE LIPS OF THE FAMISHED INFANT\nFOR THE ENEMY HAS MOISTENED HIS NECK WITH A CRUEL ARROW

arabic text: JO RAN KO GAYA RAN SE KAHAN AAYA PALAT KAR\nDETI HAI PHUPHI JAAN MUJHE YUHIN DILAASE
english translation text: WHOEVER WENT INTO THE DESERT, DID HE RETURN FROM THE DESERT?\nSAYS MY DEAR AUNT IN CONDOLENCE

arabic text: SUNTI HOO YATEEMO KI DUA RADH NAHI HOTI\nYA RAB MUJHE MILWAADE PHIR EK BAAR CHACHA SE
english translation text: I HAVE HEARD THAT AN ORPHAN'S PRAYER IS NEVER REJECTED\nO LORD, LET ME MEET ONCE AGAIN WITH MY UNCLE

arabic text: MAA BEHNE KHULE SAR HAI LAHOO ROTI HAI AANKHEIN\nUTH-TA NAHI BHAI KA MERA SAR HAI HAYA SE
english translation text: MOTHERS AND SISTERS ARE UNVEILED, THE EYES SHED TEARS OF BLOOD\nMY BROTHER CANNOT LIFT HIS HEAD FOR SHAME
